title: JobRunRecordedPayload
description: Payload of the JobRunRecorded platform event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8, §28.18; class: platform; FR-AH.15). Emitted by a scheduled job's JobRunRecorder (TPL-09). Authored by INV-T-2855 (T11); optional schedule, criticality, tolerance, scheduledFor and nextRunAt added by INV-T-3007 (INV-Q-2942, additive minor), so console-bff and notification-svc learn a job from its runs. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

job.description: The scheduled job's own name, e.g. 'scheduled-despatch' (TPL-09).

ownerService.description: The service the job runs in.

entityScope.description: The entity or business unit the run covers, absent when the job is not entity-scoped.

reason.description: Why the run failed, present when status is FAILED.

durationMillis.description: Duration of the job run, in milliseconds.

schedule.description: The job's registered schedule, as the job declared it at registration (INV-REQ-1136, INV-Q-2942). Optional; added by INV-T-3007.

criticality.description: The job's criticality as registered (INV-REQ-1136, INV-Q-2942): STANDARD, or DEADLINE_CRITICAL for a job such as scheduled submission or a readiness drain whose pause is bounded by the entity's nearest due date minus its safety margin (INV-REQ-1138 b3). Extensible (API-09, API-41). Optional; added by INV-T-3007.

tolerance.description: How late a run may be before it counts as missed, an ISO-8601 duration (INV-REQ-1136 b1, INV-REQ-1139, ruling INV-Q-2067, INV-Q-2942). Optional; added by INV-T-3007.

scheduledFor.description: The schedule tick this run belongs to (INV-Q-2942, INV-Q-2948); for a run-now, the tick of the schedule interval containing the request (INV-Q-3034). Optional; added by INV-T-3007.

nextRunAt.description: When the job is next scheduled to fire, as known at the end of this run (INV-Q-2942), so a missed run can be detected outside the owning service (INV-REQ-1139). Optional; added by INV-T-3007.
